guide_line: Classify matter as an element, compound, or mixture.
steps: An element is one kind of atom, such as O₂ or Hg.
A compound is two or more elements in a fixed ratio, such as NaCl or H₂O.
Elements and compounds are pure substances.
A mixture can be separated by physical means. If it looks the same everywhere, it is homogeneous.
If you can see different parts, the mixture is heterogeneous. An alloy such as brass is a homogeneous mixture.

similar_problem.hint: Two elements are locked in a fixed ratio.

problems.why: O₂ contains only oxygen atoms. It is an element.
hints: One kind of atom means an element.

problems.why: Sodium and chlorine are in a fixed 1:1 ratio. NaCl is a compound.
hints: A fixed formula of two elements is a compound.

problems.why: Salt water is the same throughout and can be separated by evaporating the water.
hints: A solution looks uniform. It is a homogeneous mixture.

problems.why: You can see the sand and the water as different parts.
hints: Visible parts mean a heterogeneous mixture.

problems.why: Filtered air is a uniform mixture of gases, not one pure substance.
hints: Several gases mixed evenly make a homogeneous mixture.

problems.why: Distilled water is H₂O, a pure compound.
hints: One formula, H₂O, means a compound.

problems.why: Granite shows different mineral grains. It is heterogeneous.
hints: If you can see the parts, it is heterogeneous.

problems.why: Brass is a uniform mixture of metals. An alloy is not a compound.
hints: An alloy can be separated in principle and has no single fixed formula.

problems.why: Hg is one kind of atom. It is an element.
hints: A single symbol means an element.

problems.q: Classify Italian salad dressing that has separated.
problems.why: Oil and vinegar sit in layers you can see.
hints: Layers you can see mean a heterogeneous mixture.

problems.why: CO₂ is carbon and oxygen in a fixed ratio. It is a compound.
hints: Two elements in one formula make a compound.
